description: Retired Border Security Force HS 748 Avro VT-EAV bought at government tender for about Rs 40 lakh by scrap dealers Virendra and Pushpendra Kushwaha, trucked from Delhi to their farm-stay at Shankarpur, Ujjain in Oct 2025 for conversion into a five-room aircraft hotel (Mathrubhumi, NDTV, Zee, 17-19 Oct 2025). Conversion in progress; permanently sited on the farmland. Coordinates approximate (Shankarpur). Needs check of completion.
